activity.notes: Johannes Gutenberg's most securely bounded representative activity is the production of the 42-line Gutenberg Bible in Mainz between 1452 and 1455. ATLAS records this documented printing phase under the higher-order Holy Roman Empire polity and does not invent a lifelong professional chronology from the less precisely dated stages of his technical development.

sources.title: The Gutenberg Bibles — Gutenberg Museum Mainz
sources.citation_text: The Gutenberg Museum states that Gutenberg created the two-volume 42-line Bible between 1452 and 1455 with numerous assistants.

sources.title: Gutenberg's invention — City of Mainz / Gutenberg.de
sources.citation_text: The City of Mainz's Gutenberg resource describes Gutenberg as an inventor and media revolutionary and explains his movable-metal-type printing process.
